content: QR TIGER and Uniqode treat folders as campaign containers with folder-level analytics; Uniqode also filters by owner and warns that deleting a folder trashes contained codes. Bitly/QR TIGER dashboards show scans by date, device/OS, and location; location is optional marketing SaaS, not ops table-stakes. QR vs NFC source cannot be inferred from UA; encode a marker such as ?src=nfc on the NFC write URL and default other hits to qr, which PlateFlow already parses on GET /r/:slug.
